correctness.rationale: For d>=2m>=4, sign reflection annihilates every monomial of total degree below 2m. At degree 2m only x_1...x_{2m} survives, forcing a complementary pair of squarefree degree-m harmonic monomials. Their L2 norm and sign-weighted coupling are exact Dirichlet moments Γ(d/2)/(2^mΓ(d/2+m)) and Γ(d/2)/(π^mΓ(d/2+m)); ratio (2/π)^m. The complement involution gives the complete +/- spectral multiplicities, with all lower-degree and other harmonic components in the 1/2 eigenspace. A separate moment-matrix code, implementing Laplacian-nullspace harmonic bases, passed eight finite dimension/parity configurations; this corroborates but is not the proof.

value.rationale: A natural parity-based half-area observation mask gives exact half-energy through a sharp maximal bandwidth, then a fully classified first splitting. Its sharp inverse-energy condition ratio and complementary-monomial eigenvectors quantify stable reconstruction over all ambient dimensions d>=2m, while the unusual ambient-dimension independence supplies structural insight not implied merely by the elementary sign-cancellation step.
